en.title: Decimal to Hex Converter — Coding.Tools
en.description: Convert decimal numbers to hexadecimal format directly in your browser.
en.toolDescription: Convert decimal numbers to hex, octal, and binary.
descParas: This tool converts decimal (base 10) numbers to hexadecimal (base 16), and also shows the octal (base 8) and binary (base 2) equivalents.
The conversion runs locally in your browser.
steps: Type or paste a decimal number into the input field.
Click Convert to see the hex, octal, and binary results.
Use Copy to copy the hex result to clipboard.
whatIsParas: Converting decimal to hexadecimal is useful in programming and web development. Each hex digit represents 4 binary digits.
en.inputNotesPara: Enter a valid decimal number (integer). Spaces are automatically removed.
en.examplePara: Converting a decimal number to hex:
en.exampleCode:
--- Decimal Input ---
255

--- Hex ---
FF

--- Octal ---
377

--- Binary ---
11111111
